payload.summary: All three amendments describe behaviors that are not present in the current implementation. `emit_molt_failure` already suppresses critical-GH diagnostics when `gh_min_d == 0.0`, and `molt_cycle` now honors `temp_condition_min_factor` directly, including `0.0` freezing molt cadence.

votes.rationale: `emit_molt_failure` does not unconditionally compute a synthetic GH ratio anymore. It sets `gh_ratio` only when `params.gh_min_d > 0.0`, then derives `critical_gh_failure` from that optional value, so a zero-GH-floor configuration cannot emit the claimed `critical GH ratio 0.00<...` detail.

The cited hidden `0.01` cadence floor is not in the current code path. `molt_cycle` uses `raw_temp_factor.max(params.temp_condition_min_factor)`, treats `<= 0.0` as a frozen cadence, and computes readiness as `0.0` when frozen. Combined with `temp_condition_factor` clamping to the configured minimum, sub-`0.01` values and `0.0` are honored rather than overridden.

This diagnostic-mismatch report no longer matches the implementation. In `emit_molt_failure`, `gh_ratio` is `None` when `gh_min_d == 0.0`, and the `critical GH ratio` detail is emitted only from that optional value. Zero-GH-floor runs therefore fall back to score-based messaging instead of falsely blaming GH.
